review.summary: The spec contains proposed future-state designs that are not grounded in the current system_state.json. The artifact should focus on the current state and explicitly mark all proposed changes as such.

findings.title: Ungrounded Future-State Design
findings.evidence: The spec presents a target access model, authorization rules, data model strategy, frontend changes, backend/RLS direction, migration safety, testing requirements, and non-goals as current production state.
findings.requiredAction: Mark all proposed future-state designs with clear labels indicating they are not part of the current system_state.json.

verificationChecks: Ensure all proposed future-state changes are clearly labeled

requiredAction: Escalate to Copilot for manual intervention beyond Dr Bob auto-fix scope.
